text.p: Tropical Cyclone 08B, with 60 mph winds, is in the Bay of Bengal, moving to the west, and is expected to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh, India, in about 24 hours, with top winds near 70 mph. This system will likely producing heavy rains, flash floods, and local wind damage.

Tropical Cyclone 08S is only a moderate threat to shipping in the South Indian Ocean well northeast of Madagascar, moving west southwest. Top winds are 30 mph but are expected to increase as the storm moves west southwestward through the period.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
